description.p: Télémaque is a simple BitTorrent client for GNOME, built on libtorrent (the engine of qBittorrent and Deluge). Open a .torrent file or a magnet link, choose where to save it and which files to keep, and follow your downloads. Nothing more.

Télémaque est un client BitTorrent tout simple pour GNOME, sur libtorrent (le moteur de qBittorrent et de Deluge). Ouvrez un fichier .torrent ou un lien magnet, choisissez où l'enregistrer et quels fichiers garder, et suivez vos téléchargements. Rien de plus.

Télémaque ist ein einfacher BitTorrent-Client für GNOME auf Basis von libtorrent (der Engine von qBittorrent und Deluge). Öffnen Sie eine .torrent-Datei oder einen Magnet-Link, wählen Sie Speicherort und Dateien und verfolgen Sie Ihre Downloads. Mehr nicht.

ul.li: .torrent files and magnet links (from Firefox, the clipboard or drag and drop)
Choose the files to keep, before or during the download
Pause, resume, remove with or without the files
Stops sharing at the ratio you choose; speed limits
Seeds and peers of each download; status bar with the public address, the port and the DHT
Notification when a download is finished; keeps running in the background with an icon in the top bar

Seeds und Peers jedes Downloads; Statusleiste mit öffentlicher Adresse, Port und DHT
Benachrichtigung am Ende eines Downloads; läuft mit einem Symbol in der oberen Leiste im Hintergrund weiter
A .torrent file stored in a folder whose name is not UTF-8 opens again
A download folder whose name is not UTF-8 is refused with a clear message instead of failing silently
Settings and the list of torrents are saved again after such a path was used
A file checked again on a torrent whose sharing has stopped downloads, then the sharing rule applies again
Several magnet links dropped at once are all added
A small arrow unfolds the files of a torrent under its line, each with its own progress bar
Each unfolded file can be stopped, resumed or deleted from the disk; the other files are not touched
A finished torrent no longer stays at 97% after being checked again

Rename the folder or any file of a torrent: in the add dialog, from the list (Rename…) and in Files…; the torrent stays the same for the tracker and the other peers, and an existing file is never overwritten
Select several downloads with the round check boxes on the right, then pause, resume, move or remove them together (Ctrl+A, Esc, Delete)
Move the files of a download to another folder, during or after the download; an existing file is never overwritten
Incomplete files end with .part and get their real name back once complete (option, on by default)
Fixed a crash that could happen when a move finished
New switch in Preferences → General: “Default application for torrents” (magnet links and .torrent files); when turned off, the previous application comes back
The public address follows network changes: turning a VPN on or off while Télémaque is running updates the status bar within seconds
New option “Check the public address” (on by default): asks ipify.org for the IPv4 and IPv6 address at start and when the network changes
The status bar shows both public addresses, IPv4 and IPv6 (only the last one announced was shown); the local address is gone
